Q1. 您在多大程度上同意：「座位擁擠度、溫度、噪音及濕度，是可以決定圖書館環境整體舒適度的關鍵因素」？
To what extent do you agree with the statement: "Seat crowding, temperature, noise, and humidity are the key factors determining the overall comfort of the library environment"?
column3:
Q2. 您多大程度同意「在前往圖書館之前，我希望能夠預先掌握目前館內總人數與擁擠程度，評估是否能順利找到座位，避開人潮高峰」？
To what extent do you agree: "Before visiting the library, I want to check the current crowd level and occupancy so I can ensure I'll find a seat and avoid peak hours."？
column4:
Q3. 您在多大程度上同意：「 如果有一個即時互動網頁，能清楚顯示圖書館各區域的即時環境狀況（如溫濕度、噪音），將能有效協助我避開不舒適的區域，提升學習效率。」？

To what extent do you agree: "If there is a real-time interactive website that clearly displays the real-time environmental conditions across different library zones (such as temperature, humidity and noise), it will effectively help me avoid uncomfortable areas and enhance my study efficiency."？
